# Security policy

The Resgrid apps (Responder, Unit, IC, Dispatch and BigBoard) are used by first responders, dispatchers and emergency managers. Please report security problems privately so they can be fixed before they are public.

## Reporting a vulnerability

- **Do not open a public issue**, discussion or pull request for a security problem.
- Report it privately with GitHub: on the [Security tab](https://github.com/Resgrid/Omni/security), choose **Report a vulnerability**. If that button is not shown, use the [Resgrid contact form](https://resgrid.com/contact) and ask for a private channel; do not include the details in the first message.
- Include the app (Responder, Unit, IC, Dispatch or BigBoard), the platform, the app version (Settings → About → Version), what an attacker could do, and the steps to reproduce.
- Never include real passwords, tokens or personal data in a report; use a test account.

Problems in the Resgrid server or the resgrid.com web application belong to [Resgrid Core](https://github.com/Resgrid/Core); report them the same way there.

## Supported versions

Fixes ship in the latest release of each app, through the app stores, an over-the-air update or a new web and desktop release. Older versions are not patched.
